CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild anemia, leukopenia, and thrombocytopenia. Total serum protein is decreased, while other biochemistry and liver enzymes are within normal limits. There is also mild basophilia. These findings may suggest a chronic or acute systemic process such as infection, inflammation, or bone marrow suppression. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
Provider Organization: Spitalul de Psihiatrie Palazu Mare
